source_derived_geometry.extractor: 4 x Conv2d(k=5,s=2,p=2) [no activations] + 6 x ResBlock(32) + Conv2d(32->32,k=3,p=1); fully convolutional; scale = 16
source_derived_geometry.pixel_to_feature: t px translation with 16 | t  ->  tau = t/16 feature cells, EXACT in the interior
source_derived_geometry.cost_volume_shift_left: V[k][w] = Lf[w+k] - Rf[w] for w < W_f - k; 0 - Rf[w] for w >= W_f - k
source_derived_geometry.cost_volume_shift_none: V[k][w] = Lf[w] - Rf[w] for EVERY k (candidate-constant; EXP-010)
source_derived_geometry.self_pair_substitution: Rf[w] = Lf[w+tau]  =>  V(k,w) = F(k-tau, w+tau), F tau-independent; V = 0 EXACTLY at k = tau
source_derived_geometry.sign_convention: right[y,x] = left[y,x+t]  =>  d = x_left - x_right = +t px  =>  k_true = tau = t/16
source_derived_geometry.readout: aggregate -> bilinear upsample (align_corners=True) -> z = (c - mean_k c)/(sd_k c + 1e-5) -> softmax(-z) -> soft-argmin over 0..11
source_derived_geometry.match_is_a: MINIMUM of z(k), because of the negation inside softmax(-z)
source_derived_geometry.disparity_initial_reason: soft_argmin emits candidate units 0..11; the scale is supplied by the refinement stage, which is never run; the scalar is additionally softmax-compressed toward the grid centre
source_derived_geometry.resolution: the primary statistic is an INTEGER argmin over the candidate axis in native candidate units; it is invariant to the per-pixel affine standardisation and immune to softmax compression; the exact conversion 1 candidate = 16 px is recorded and used by NO step of the decision rule

construction.left_crop: rows [0,272), cols [0,1136)  -- FIXED in every condition
construction.tau_zero_exclusion_reason: at tau = 0 the matched cells are byte-identical, so V == 0 exactly and the aggregation receives NO image information; a structurally distinct regime (POSTMORTEM Task B, ALGEBRA_AUDIT 4). Excluded entirely, never used as a baseline.
construction.balance_property: each source appears exactly once as a left and once as a right, so every first-order (main) effect cancels IDENTICALLY, not approximately

cancellation_identity.statement: V_AA + V_BB - V_AB - V_BA == 0 identically, for every k, w, tau
cancellation_identity.proof: (Af[w+k] - Af[w+tau]) + (Bf[w+k] - Bf[w+tau]) - (Af[w+k] - Bf[w+tau]) - (Bf[w+k] - Af[w+tau]) = 0; build_cost_volume is linear in both feature maps
consequences: any AFFINE aggregation returns an identically-zero aggregated-cost interaction for ANY weights, including the entire D-axis padding boundary
a candidate-constant volume gives an identically-zero interaction (the shift=none special case)
the forced translation V(k,w) = F(k-tau, w+tau) applies to matched AND crossed cells alike, so it contributes only through the nonlinearity
every additive main effect cancels: left identity, right identity, tau, crop geometry, receptive-field edge contamination, architecture, padding

terminology.synthetic geometric pairing response: the response depends on which images are paired, at the imposed candidate -- ATTAINABLE
terminology.architectural correspondence: produced by the operator irrespective of weights -- the G_STOP outcome
terminology.learned correspondence: weight-dependent and attributable to matching -- only PARTIALLY attainable; the gate shows weight-dependence, never that the mechanism is matching

claim_ceiling.irreducible_gap: nothing in this design separates learned correspondence from a learned NON-correspondence shortcut that happens to place its nonlinear pairing minimum at k = tau. ALGEBRA_AUDIT 5.3 marks this UNKNOWN and not addressable by any ablation of this architecture on synthetic input. It remains UNKNOWN.
claim_ceiling.OOD_caveat: a constant-disparity plane is not natural stereo; a NEGATIVE result remains ambiguous. Declared in advance. Mitigated only in that both arms draw on the same 12 real KITTI frames, so the OOD penalty is carried equally by POSITIVE and NEGATIVE and is cancelled by the interaction.

cheapest_discriminating_experiment: Hold the translation fixed and swap the pairing. At each tau in {1..6}, for two real KITTI frames A and B, run four forward passes -- (A,A_tau), (B,B_tau), (A,B_tau), (B,A_tau) -- and test the single boolean argmin_k Ibar_tau(k) == tau, with the random-weight arm run FIRST as a gate. The architectural artifact lives in the LINEAR part of the operator and the cost volume is linear in both feature maps, so the artifact cancels EXACTLY in the 2x2 interaction. ~15000 inference passes, 5-10 minutes, no training.
